sentences.text: Across all their report types, Arup US’s reports score lower than Mortenson’s and can’t be told apart from WSP’s or JE Dunn Construction’s.
The most common flag in every firm’s reports is a claim that cites nothing: 67 to 73 in every 100 claims.
Arup US’s reports score a typical 0.9 points lower than Mortenson’s (95% interval 0.1 to 1.8; 351 and 27 reports).

Mortenson publishes more industry or market reports, which score higher across The List; comparing like with like, the gap can’t be told apart from chance (0.6 points lower to 0.3 points higher; 243 and 27 reports).
JE Dunn Construction publishes more industry or market reports, which score higher across The List; comparing like with like leaves too few reports of the same types (2 and 7) to tell.
